An '''Ammo caster''' is where Smiths create improved [[cv:Metal|metal]] ammo from metal [[cv:bar|bars]].

==Menu==

'''Ammo caster'''

*{{K|c}} Cast copper broadhead bolts (50)
*{{K|C}} Cast copper piercing bolts (50)
*{{K|alt+c}} Cast copper hammerhead bolts (50)
*{{K|b}} Cast bronze broadhead bolts (50)
*{{K|B}} Cast bronze piercing bolts (50)
*{{K|alt+b}} Cast bronze hammerhead bolts (50)
*{{K|i}} Cast iron broadhead bolts (50)
*{{K|I}} Cast iron piercing bolts (50)
*{{K|alt+I}} Cast iron hammerhead bolts (50)
*{{K|s}} Cast steel broadhead bolts (50)
*{{K|S}} Cast steel piercing bolts (50)
*{{K|alt+s}} Cast steel hammerhead bolts (50)
*{{K|a}} Cast adamentine broadhead bolts (50)
*{{K|A}} Cast adamentine piercing bolts (50)
*{{K|alt+a}} Cast adamentine hammerhead bolts (50)
*{{K|c}} Cast copper broadhead arrows (50)
*{{K|C}} Cast copper piercing arrows (50)
*{{K|alt+c}} Cast copper hammerhead arrows (50)
*{{K|b}} Cast bronze broadhead arrows (50)
*{{K|B}} Cast bronze piercing arrows (50)
*{{K|alt+b}} Cast bronze hammerhead arrows (50)
*{{K|i}} Cast iron broadhead arrows (50)
*{{K|I}} Cast iron piercing arrows (50)
*{{K|alt+I}} Cast iron hammerhead arrows (50)
*{{K|s}} Cast steel broadhead arrows (50)
*{{K|S}} Cast steel piercing arrows (50)
*{{K|alt+s}} Cast steel hammerhead arrows (50)
*{{K|a}} Cast adamentine broadhead arrows (50)
*{{K|A}} Cast adamentine piercing arrows (50)
*{{K|alt+a}} Cast adamentine hammerhead arrows (50)
*{{K|c}} Cast copper broadhead javelins (25)
*{{K|C}} Cast copper piercing javelins (25)
*{{K|alt+c}} Cast copper hammerhead javelins (25)
*{{K|b}} Cast bronze broadhead javelins (25)
*{{K|B}} Cast bronze piercing javelins (25)
*{{K|alt+b}} Cast bronze hammerhead javelins (25)
*{{K|i}} Cast iron broadhead javelins (25)
*{{K|I}} Cast iron piercing javelins (25)
*{{K|alt+I}} Cast iron hammerhead javelins (25)
*{{K|s}} Cast steel broadhead javelins (25)
*{{K|S}} Cast steel piercing javelins (25)
*{{K|alt+s}} Cast steel hammerhead javelins (25)
*{{K|a}} Cast adamentine broadhead javelins (25)
*{{K|A}} Cast adamentine piercing javelins (25)
*{{K|alt+a}} Cast adamentine hammerhead javelins (25)

==Uses==
* Broadhead ammo can sever body parts
* Hammerhead ammo deals bludgeoning damage making it effective against heavily armored targets
* piercing ammo is an improved version of the regular ammo.

==Notes==
* The hotkeys {{K|c}}, {{K|C}}, {{K|alt+c}}, {{K|b}}, {{K|B}}, {{K|alt+b}}, {{K|i}}, {{K|I}}, {{K|alt+i}}, {{K|s}}, {{K|S}}, {{K|alt+s}}, {{K|a}}, {{K|A}}, {{K|alt+a}}are listed as being used multiply times. Using these keys creates the items first listed with the hotkey in the menu (for example, {{K|b}} creates armor stands, not magma-safe blocks).
